exposure: fetal occiput posterior (OP) position at delivery
fetal occiput anterior (OA) position at delivery
outcome: duration of the active phase of labor
cohort: The study included 112,019 women from three university hospitals in Norway between 2012 and 2022, who had a single fetus in cephalic presentation, no previous cesarean section, and a gestational age of >=37 weeks.
finding: The estimated mean duration of the active phase of labor was significantly longer in women with the fetus in OP position compared to OA position in all four Robson ten-group classification system (TGCS) groups.
mod_finding: Operative delivery rates were higher in cases of occiput posterior position in all four Robson TGCS groups.
